tools.name: move_relative
tools.description: Move TCP in robot/world axes: forward +X, left +Y, up +Z. small=2cm, medium=5cm, large=10cm. Preserves orientation. Local servo only; no collision planning.

tools.name: set_gripper
tools.description: Command gripper open/close while holding TCP position. Completion is not grasp success.

tools.name: move_to_pixel
tools.description: Reach a currently visible RGB-D surface pixel, or 8cm above it. Not a free-space waypoint or grasp-pose estimator. Preserves orientation; no collision avoidance. Use a fresh observation_id. Pixel [u,v], top-left origin.

tools.name: run_vla
tools.description: Execute a bounded π0.5 policy segment with contract libero_franka_osc7_v1. One chunk executes at most 10 native actions, observing between chunks. No success oracle; reobserve and decide after the segment. Preserves full policy orientation control. Checkpoint is fixed by the operator.

tools.name: program_bounded_full_goal_delegation
tools.description: Unchanged bounded delegation implementation; the only intervention is adding the observed Object task to caller-side initial routing alongside Spatial and drawer opening. args has only instruction, supplied as the exact complete original goal. Two nonnested literal-range loops provide two primitive call sites, at most eight invocations and 320 control ticks, within the 321-tick operator limit; runtime enforces the 600-second limit. VLA reobserves between chunks. Native terminal success interrupts execution automatically. Any primitive failure is propagated before further motion. Exhaustion returns control without asserting task success and does not itself end the episode. No evaluator query, scene constants, manual gripper intervention, or grasp inference.
